text:
sam: FYI vendor (Maria @ CargoLine) says a 24-unit spot-lift destined for Nordic pool is held at Gothenburg customs for 'technical documentation' and forwarder is asking for RMA escrow before release.

maya: ugh. is this the cold-chain batch with temperature sensors?

maria-cargo: yes — batch ID CX-NRD-224, 24 units, container CNTR8921. sensors show green. customs flagged missing return label metadata and a mismatch on PO# vs invoice. they refuse release until paper/escrow confirmed.

oleksandr: can we accept escrow for RMA on vendor terms or push vendor to reissue labels? Finance needs PO/invoice parity to approve escrow.

eli: quick checklist: 1) serial range 9200-9223 2) require RMA labels (temp ones ok) 3) consolidate AWB or split? 4) customs wants HS code clarification for 'compute modules'

maria-cargo: vendor can reissue labels but needs Redwood to confirm acceptance of temporary escrow flow. they propose escrow token -> hold release, then final RMA docs after staging.

sam: i'm leaning to accept temporary escrow so we don't lose the window. risk: if any DOA we may be stuck on return shipping until claims processed. what's the cost delta?

maria-cargo: forwarder quoted detention + admin = SEK 42,000 (~$3.7k) for another 48h, or SEK 12,000 (~$1k) if we sign escrow & release now.

maya: can we push for a partial release? accept 12 units to get some capacity online and keep rest blocked until docs?

oleksandr: Nordic pool urgently needs 8 GPUs this week. partial release ok if vendor can segregate serials and supply manifest. will we require separate RMA numbers per split? customs likely wants one manifest but AWB can be split.

sam: okay ask vendor for a manifest and a short-term escrow agreement (1 week). logistics-bot: please auto-create a temporary RMA bucket named "nordic-spot-1717659999" and set TTL 7d.

logistics-bot: created RMA bucket nordic-spot-1717659999 (TTL 7d). link: https://redwood.internal/rma/nordic-spot-1717659999

maria-cargo: attaching manifest excerpt —

```
Container: CNTR8921
Batch: CX-NRD-224
Serials: 9200,9201,9202,9203,9204,9205,9206,9207,9208,9209,9210,9211,9212,9213,9214,9215,9216,9217,9218,9219,9220,9221,9222,9223
Partial release plan: first 12 serials to AWB NL123456, remaining 12 to remain in container
```

eli: nice. maria, can vendor confirm they will reissue RMA labels for the 12 releasing units and attach photos of sealed crates for customs?

maria-cargo: yes will do within 90min.

sam: finance — @maya please confirm you can approve the SEK 12k release fee under the temporary escrow path?

maya: give me 30min to check contract. if PO/invoice parity is fine i approve.

oleksandr: operational next steps once approved: 1) vendor reissues labels 2) logistics-bot generate release checklist + AWB 3) ops to tag 8 units for Nordic pool immediate staging 4) create return instructions in RMA bucket

sam: perfect. if customs escalates then we absorb SEK42k. cross-posting to procurement for record. :white_check_mark:

maria-cargo: sending photos + reissued labels now. thanks all.
